app.unexpectedErrorBody: Reconnecting to the robot… if you just submitted Wi-Fi settings, rejoin your home network and reopen this page.

common.networkError: Could not reach Palmimo. Check your connection and try again.

unavailable.title: Palmimo is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: This device could not confirm its own setup state. Wait a moment and try again — if this keeps happening, contact support.

corrupt.title: Palmimo needs manual recovery
corrupt.bodyWithReset: This device's saved credentials could not be read. Delete auth.json over SSH, or reset the login below.

setup.title: Set up Palmimo
setup.body: Choose a password to finish setting up this device.

login.stickerBody: Enter the password printed on the sticker under this device.
login.title: Log in
login.hint: Can't find the sticker? See the quick-start guide in the box.

resetLogin.title: Reset your login
resetLogin.body: This erases this Palmimo's password and returns it to a state where you can log in with the initial password printed on the sticker.
resetLogin.point1: Wi-Fi settings and SSH keys are kept
resetLogin.point2: After resetting, you'll need the password on the device's sticker
resetLogin.point3: Anyone on the same network can do this (it only resets — it cannot be used to take over the device)
resetLogin.dialogBody: After resetting, log in with the initial password printed on the device's sticker.
resetLogin.successBody: Log in with the initial password on the device's sticker.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.body: For your device's security, set a password only you know before continuing.

wifi.scanBody: Choose your home network. Palmimo needs Wi-Fi to finish setup.
wifi.waitingBody: Palmimo is switching to your Wi-Fi network “{{ssid}}”. The Wi-Fi that Palmimo itself broadcasts (“{{hostname}}”) will disappear in a few seconds — that is expected.
wifi.waitingStep1: Reconnect your phone or computer to your usual Wi-Fi ({{ssid}})
wifi.waitingStep2: As soon as Palmimo is found, this page switches over automatically. If it does not, tap the URL below.
wifi.waitingBackToScan: Back to the network list (the connection attempt continues)
wifi.waitingFailureNote: If the connection fails — for example, a wrong password — Palmimo will bring back its own Wi-Fi (“{{hostname}}”) in about a minute. Rejoin that Wi-Fi and start again from this screen.
wifi.lastAttemptFailed: The last connection attempt to "{{ssid}}" failed. Double-check the password and try again.
wifi.lastAttemptFailedDifferentNetwork: Palmimo joined a different known network ("{{observed}}") instead of "{{ssid}}". Choose "{{ssid}}" again if that's the one you want.
wifi.reconfigureNote: The current connection ({{ssid}}) will be deleted as soon as you connect to a new network.
wifi.waitingTimedOut: Palmimo has not been found yet. If its own Wi-Fi network (“{{hostname}}”) reappeared, rejoin it and try again from this screen — or try opening http://{{hostname}}.local directly.

wifiSettings.title: Wi-Fi
wifiSettings.subtitle: See and change the network Palmimo is on
wifiSettings.noteBody: Palmimo will disconnect from {{ssid}} and bring back its own Wi-Fi (“{{hostname}}”). You will be disconnected from this page, so reconnect from your phone or computer to that Wi-Fi to set it up again.
wifiSettings.reconnectDialogBody: The current connection's settings ({{ssid}}) will be deleted and Palmimo will connect to the new network. If that fails, Palmimo will bring back its own Wi-Fi (“{{hostname}}”).
wifiSettings.terminalTitle: Palmimo is switching back to its own Wi-Fi
wifiSettings.terminalBody: Once “{{hostname}}” appears in your phone's or computer's Wi-Fi list, join it and reopen this page (http://{{hostname}}.local).
wifiSettings.terminalDroppedNote: The connection dropped before Palmimo answered — that is expected.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.diskLowWarning: This device is low on disk space ({{freeGb}} GB free).

sshKeys.title: SSH keys
sshKeys.body: Keys listed here can log in to Palmimo over SSH as its OS user.
sshKeys.sshCommandNote: Using a key of your own? Replace the file name after -i.
sshKeys.uploadHelp: Choose a public key file such as ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub, or paste its contents as a single line.
sshKeys.chooseGenerate: Create a key in this browser
sshKeys.chooseGenerateHelp: Choose this if you do not have an SSH key yet.
sshKeys.chooseRegister: Register a key you already have
sshKeys.chooseRegisterHelp: Choose this if you already have a file such as ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub.
sshKeys.commentHelp: Names this key in the list above, so several people can tell theirs apart.
sshKeys.lastKeyDialogBody: This is the last key on file. Palmimo will no longer accept SSH logins until a new key is added from this page — your Portal login itself is unaffected.
sshKeys.generatedNoteTitle: A lost private key cannot be recovered. Generate a new one if you lose it
sshKeys.generatedNoteDownloaded:
Palmimo downloaded {{filename}}.
Check your downloads folder for it (press "Download again" if it is not there).
sshKeys.generatedNoteInstallIntro: Once you have found the key, run these two lines on your computer.
sshKeys.generatedNoteSafety: The key was created inside this browser and never sent to Palmimo.
sshKeys.generateErrorMessage: Key generation failed. Your browser may not support it after all -- try a recent Chrome or Safari, or add a key from another device instead.
sshKeys.confirmedNoteBody: The matching public key has been filled in below. Click "Add key" to register it.

power.title: Power
power.systemsNoteTitle: Palmimo DevKit has two power systems (servo power and Raspberry Pi power)
power.systemsNoteBody: Servo power is controlled by the servo power switch on Palmimo's back. Control the Raspberry Pi's power from this screen or over SSH (unplugging the USB Type-C cable while it is running can corrupt the SD card).
power.shutdownStep2: Switch the servo power switch off (the servos stop holding too)
power.shutdownStep3: Shut down the Raspberry Pi from this screen
power.shutdownStep4: To cut power to the product completely, unplug the DC plug and the USB Type-C cable from Palmimo
power.restartCardDescription: Restarts the Raspberry Pi inside Palmimo. This screen loses its connection for about a minute, then returns automatically once Palmimo is back (servos that are under torque keep holding).
power.shutdownCardDescription: Safely stops the Raspberry Pi inside Palmimo (servos that are under torque keep holding). To start it again after a shutdown, unplug the USB Type-C cable and plug it back in.
power.restartDialogBody: Palmimo will be unreachable for a short while as it restarts.
power.shutdownDialogBody: The Raspberry Pi will stop and stay off until you re-plug its power (USB Type-C). Servos that are under torque keep holding.
power.rebootingBody: This page will reload when Palmimo is back.
power.shuttingDownBody: Wait a moment before unplugging the power. To start Palmimo again, unplug the Raspberry Pi's power (USB Type-C) and plug it back in, then reopen this page.
power.updateInProgress: An update is in progress. Restart and shut down are disabled until it finishes.

update.title: Update
update.notes: The Portal will be unresponsive for a few minutes while updating, and restarts automatically once it's done. Make sure the robot is not moving before you start.
update.rollbackTitle: Go back to the previous version
update.rollbackNote: If something goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the tag that was running before.
update.restartingBody: This page will reload once Palmimo is back.
update.restartTimedOut: Palmimo has not come back yet. Power-cycle the device; if the Portal still does not start, roll back over SSH.
update.platformReflashRequired: This update requires reflashing the SD card; it cannot be applied in place.
update.platformPortalTooOld: Update the Portal itself before updating the device platform.
update.platformVerifyDiffBanner: The device platform has drifted from its recorded version. Reapply the update to fix it.
update.platformLegacyLedger: Reset the apps first, then update the device platform.
